guide_intro: Two ways to test: automatic (the scanner does everything) or manual (you pick the payload and test it by hand).
guide_step1_title: Pick a target with a parameter
guide_step1_body: Paste a URL that has something to inject in the query string, like <0>?id=1</0> or <1>?cat=2</1>. If the endpoint only accepts POST, fill in the Body field too (format <2>key=value&other=value</2>). If you need a login/session, paste the header in <3>Headers</3> (e.g. <4>Authorization: Bearer ...</4> or <5>Cookie: session=...</5>).
guide_step2_body: The scanner swaps each parameter's value, one at a time, through each of the 18 wordlist payloads, and compares the response to a "clean" request (baseline) to spot differences in error, status, size, or time.
guide_step3_title: Manual mode: click "Use" on the wordlist
guide_step3_body: Copies the payload to the clipboard. Paste it directly into the URL (in place of the parameter value), into the Body, or send it to Repeater to see the full response yourself.
guide_step4_body: Each tested parameter becomes a card. Only payloads that produced some signal show up there; the "no signal" ones stay hidden (counted in the card's footer).
guide_icon_critical_body: <0>Critical</0>: database error in the response, or a confirmed time delay. Strong signal of a real SQLi.
guide_icon_warning_body: <0>Warning</0>: response status or size changed. Could be SQLi, could be coincidence; worth investigating by hand.
guide_icon_info_body: <0>Info</0>: nothing abnormal detected for this payload.
guide_payload_error_body: <0>Error-based</0>: tries to break the query (quotes, UNION SELECT) expecting a SQL syntax error to leak into the response.
guide_payload_boolean_body: <0>Boolean-based</0>: injects always-true/always-false conditions (<1>OR 1=1</1>) expecting the response content to change.
guide_payload_time_body: <0>Time-based</0>: injects a delay (<1>SLEEP(3)</1>) and measures whether the response really took longer, useful when there's no error or visible difference ("blind" SQLi).
guide_footer_note: This makes real requests against the target (including deliberate delays). Only use it on targets you have explicit authorization to test.
manual_no_params_body: No parameters detected yet, add <0>?name=value</0> to the URL or fill in the Body.
manual_payload_label: Payload (pick from the wordlist below or edit freely)
no_params_body: No parameters found in the URL (query string) or the body. Add some to test, e.g. <0>?id=1</0>.
boolean_test_body: We send a condition that should always be <0>true</0> and another that's always <1>false</1>. If the site responds differently to each one, that's a strong signal of SQL injection. If it responds the same to both, there's no signal here.
boolean_pair_summary: true → status {{trueStatus}} ({{trueLength}} bytes) · false → status {{falseStatus}} ({{falseLength}} bytes)
error_delay_body: Each row below only shows up if some payload caused a visible database error in the response, or took much longer than normal to respond (time-based "blind" SQLi signal).
test_button_title: Load this request into Automatic mode above for further manual testing
batch_scan_description: Runs the same check against every request already captured in Proxy History, instead of one URL at a time. Filter by host to keep it scoped to a target you're authorized to test: leave it blank to scan everything in History.
empty_description: Optionally set a host filter above and click Start scan.
